reply.emotion: warm and cozy, pulling on a favorite pair of socks on a chilly morning
notes: Meia is also used as the feminine form of the number meio (half), as in meia hora (half an hour).

senses.definition: Soft clothing worn on the foot, usually inside a shoe.

examples.text: Eu preciso calçar a meia antes de colocar o tênis.
examples.translation: I need to put on the sock before putting on my sneakers.
examples.emotion: practical and everyday, getting dressed quickly to leave the house

senses.definition: One of two equal parts of a whole.

examples.text: Comprei uma dúzia e meia de laranjas.
examples.translation: I bought a dozen and a half oranges.
examples.emotion: casual and matter-of-fact while doing routine grocery shopping
